author: dg_sigma_claude (independent Claude reviewer)
scope: TensorBoard scalars via scripts/_runs.py plus NumPy Gaussian toys. No network execution, GPU, training or source edits.

step_mapping.measured: first charts/SPS at env 32384 = 16000 phase-warmup transitions + one 16384 recorded warmup rollout; first learn() at env 48768
step_mapping.rule: env_step at the end of a learning burst = learner_step + 32384; charts/sigma_*, losses/*, gradients/*, charts/*_target use learner steps; delight/*, gradient_probe/*, actor/kl*, eval and returns use env steps
step_mapping.note: delight/* is written ~16 times per rollout at the same env step (every 1000 learner steps, one minibatch each)

v10_alpha_controller.interpretation: inferred: gradient of exp(log_alpha)*(H - target) is ~3e-11, far below Adam eps 1e-8, so the step is lr*g/eps instead of lr. The measured slope matches that formula; the controller cannot recover in either direction on a training timescale.

toy_scale_coefficients.definition: d=6 Gaussian, 400k antithetic draws, Q(a)=sum_j G a_j - k a_j^2/2 on a=clip(mu+sigma eps,-1,1) (clip off where stated). Columns: expected log-sigma coefficient E[w U (eps_j^2-1)] averaged over coordinates. dg_v10 = 2*sigmoid(U*min(.5|eps|^2,10)) raw; dg_density = 2*sigmoid(U*clip(-log N(u),-10,10)); dg_execrarity = rarity from the executed clipped action; dg_hard = 2*1[U>0].

temperature_sweep.definition: Q depends on coordinates 0-2 only; 3-5 are flat. Gate 2*sigmoid(U*r/(t*RMS(U))); t=inf is PG.

toy_scale_coefficients.Q_definition: Q(a)=sum_j mask_j*(G*a_j - 0.5*k*a_j^2), a=clip(mu+sigma*eps,-1,1) when clip=true else a=mu+sigma*eps; mu and sigma are scalars shared by all 6 coordinates; U=Q-b. ref=modal: b=Q(clip(mu)); ref=mean: b=Monte Carlo mean of Q over the same draws; boff is added to b. No reward or advantage normalisation; gate temperature 1 in these raw units; rarity .5*|eps|^2 capped at 10; density surprisal .5*|eps|^2 + 6*log(sigma) + 3*log(2*pi) clipped to [-10,10]; all gates doubled (2*sigmoid).

C_offopt_modal.note: unclipped optimum at a=0.3 per coordinate

C_offopt_meanref.note: unclipped optimum at a=0.3 per coordinate

D_boundary_modal.note: unclipped optimum at a=3, outside the box

D_boundary_meanref.note: unclipped optimum at a=3, outside the box

toy_scale_coefficients.scenario_draws: 200k Gaussian draws plus their negations, seed 0

root_fixture_crosscheck.Q: -0.3*sum_{j<3} eps_j^2 (fixed in eps units, 3 curved + 3 flat coordinates), 400k draws plus negations, seed 2; values are curved/flat
root_fixture_crosscheck.agreement: root's native quadrature at sigma .145: modal relative +.052/+.041, density -.637/+.248; exact-mean relative -.281/+.051, density -.423/+.117

toy_scale_coefficients.constraint_check: Root's identity: for mu=0, isotropic Q=-c*sum eps^2 with exact mean reference, U=c(D-R) and E[eps_j^2-1|R]=R/D-1, so any positive gate depending only on R gives scale coefficient -cD*E[w(R)(R/D-1)^2] <= 0. A_quad_meanref satisfies it for every gate and sigma (all entries negative). The positive density entries occur only with a modal reference (A_quad_modal) or off-optimum with a linear term (C_*, D_*).

limits: ceiling/floor fractions and geometric sigma are logged only in v10; other runs expose arithmetic mean and batch min/max (min ~0.007 and max 1.0 in every run)
toys use Gaussian-tailed quadratic Q and isotropic sigma; logged gate fractions imply heavier advantage tails in the real run
probe quantities are one 256-state minibatch per rollout
